name: Summer Youth Employment Program (SYEP)
what_you_do: A paid summer job for 8 weeks with a government office, library, nonprofit or business. You first get 3 days of job skills training.
who_can_apply: Broward County students ages 16 to 18. You must be able to work in the US and have a valid ID. Your family must meet the income rule (economically disadvantaged). Picked by random lottery.
duration: About 8 weeks, June to early August
deadline_text: The 2026 application period is closed. The 2026 program ran June to August 2026. Watch the page for the 2027 window.
how_to_apply: Apply online when the window is open. Income and a random lottery decide who gets in. Chosen youth get a packet by mail and go to training.
notes: Funded mainly by the Children's Services Council of Broward County. Remote work is not offered. Next year dates are not posted, so check the page in winter.
